evaluations.prompt:
is this rocprof-compute kernel compute bound or memory bound?

The application is ./vcopy.cpp.
expected_behavior: analyzes the roof block for a single kernel id
compares arithmetic intensity against the empirical peaks printed in the table
says when the kernel is below both ceilings instead of forcing a bound
unexpected_behavior: opens the generated roofline HTML chart instead of reading the table
calculates a peak instead of using the measured one

evaluations.prompt:
what is the arithmetic intensity of my hottest kernel and how much performance am I leaving on the table?

The application is ./mat_mul_max.hip.
expected_behavior: reads FLOPs per byte and the peak values from the roofline table
narrows to one kernel id first

evaluations.prompt:
my matrix multiply sits far below the top ceiling on the roofline, is it slow?

The application is ./mat_mul_max.hip.
expected_behavior: reads the precision from the instruction mix rather than assuming it
compares against the FP32 peak, not the highest matrix or FP16 peak
unexpected_behavior: calls the kernel slow because it is below the highest ceiling in the table

unexpected_behavior: tells the user to re-profile without --no-roof when the architecture is the actual reason
